_meta.name: Cloudburst Ventures seed config
_meta.purpose: Initial data for the Funding Pulse app. Loaded into the database on first run; edited afterwards through the My Coverage sidebar. Export and import use this same shape.
notes: Portfolio is illustrative and modelled on a publicly listed early-stage portfolio. Acquired and wound-down companies were excluded.
Portfolio sectors follow the source listing's category tabs. Companies from its miscellaneous tab were assigned to a sector manually.
Company descriptions are short paraphrases. Domains come from each company's own website link.
On Radar entries come from funding news dated roughly 15 Aug to 12 Oct 2026. Each has an evidence URL and is single-source; verify before relying on any figure.
Priority values are an analyst suggestion and are editable.
Climate coverage in On Radar is thin because the news search returned few early-stage climate rounds. The weekly pipeline will add more.
Entries with match_requires_context share a name with other companies; the matcher should require one of the listed context words nearby.
No API keys belong in this file. Keys go in environment variables.
